newsitem.title: USA: Ohio resolution would set vote on $2 bln of GOs.
newsitem.headline: Ohio resolution would set vote on $2 bln of GOs.

text.p: An Ohio lawmaker has introduced a resolution calling for a state-wide vote on a constitutional amendment to allow the state to issue up to $2 billion of general obligation bonds for environmental projects.
The resolution, introduced by State Rep. William Schuck, R-Columbus, would require a super-majority vote of each legislative chamber in order to appear on the ballot, according to Schuck's office.
The introduction of the resolution marked the second try by Schuck, who introduced a similar measure last year, his office said.
A second resolution introduced by Schuck this year would amend the constitution to allow the state to loan out proceeds from the bonds to local governments.
